purpose: Define the operating inputs and scope boundaries required to calculate T-5.6 trunk and shoulder loads without inventing fabrication values.

authority.rule: A locked value requires a project decision or traceable engineering source. Concept imagery is never dimensional authority.

required_inputs.question: What is the maximum ready-to-operate mass including batteries, covers, fascia, and nominal carried equipment?

required_inputs.evidence: project-local A0 design requirement; physical capability unverified
required_inputs.question: What mass is carried outboard of one humeral shoulder cartridge, including hand, forearm, humerus, wiring, guards, and nominal payload interface?

required_inputs.evidence: project-local A0 design requirement; physical capability unverified
required_inputs.question: What maximum payload may one hand carry during ordinary domestic manipulation?

required_inputs.evidence: project-local A0 low-speed control requirement; not a measured capability
required_inputs.question: What commanded shoulder angular velocity bounds normal operation?

required_inputs.evidence: project-local A0 control requirement; not a measured capability
required_inputs.question: What commanded angular acceleration bounds normal and emergency stopping motion?

required_inputs.evidence: project-local A0 proof requirement; test result remains open
required_inputs.question: What accidental fore-aft or lateral force must the arm and shoulder withstand without structural release?

required_inputs.evidence: project-local guarded-impact boundary; test result remains open
required_inputs.question: What impact energy defines a minor domestic collision rather than an out-of-scope crash?

required_inputs.evidence: A0 demonstration target; cycle and inspection evidence remains open
required_inputs.question: How many representative shoulder cycles define the design life before overhaul?

required_inputs.evidence: A0 sizing policy; allowables and proof evidence remain open
required_inputs.question: Which safety factors apply to yield, ultimate, buckling, joint retention, bonded inserts, and fatigue?
What maximum accessible surface temperature is acceptable for sustained domestic contact?
What sustained pressure limit applies to reclined and side-contact postures?

required_inputs.evidence: A0 design target at 1 m, no payload, 20 deg/s; measurement remains open
required_inputs.question: At what measurement distance and operating condition is the shoulder acoustic limit defined?

required_inputs.evidence: A0 supported-service design requirement; physical test remains open
required_inputs.question: What external force may be applied during cartridge removal, transport, or supported maintenance?

closure_rule: Every required input must have status locked, a non-null value, units where applicable, an authority, and an evidence reference before load cases may be approved.
